gpt.text: Utvara is where Uncle makes Teysa baroness, and they travel there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix, though Uncle reveals he had Hauc drop the mana bomb, which goes awry, creating the Schism and mutating the plague. Aun Yom is killed and rises again, his band attacks the lokopede, and Uncle is killed.

Teysa hires Aradoz and charges Dr. Nebun with curing the Kuga plague, and Nebun reveals that he always had a cure, which Teysa buys. She discovers Melisk has been erasing her memory and that Uncle's death was an Obzedat scheme, so she breaks her oath, rallies Utvara against the Cauldron and takes control of the Taj, who murder Melisk.

In a dogfight Hauc dies as the two dragons kill each other, and Kos is impaled in the crash, sees Feather emerge from the kuga mot, and dies. At his funeral Hauc's spirit awakens, hearing the voices of other spirits.
